purpose: Independent reproduction attempt of URformer v3 explicit equations and published physical/training settings; not an exact author-code replication.

published.loss: Eq20 mean normalized per-example squared channel error
published.initializer: Independent zero-mean complex Gaussian normalized variance
published.ratio_denominator: Expected total multiuser signal power E|Hs|^2

assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.code_search: No author repository or weights linked in arXiv source/abstract; exact title+URformer+GitHub searches found none. Not proof that none exist.
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.gains: Independent CN(0,1); no extra channel Frobenius normalization; expected per-entry channel power M=32 with printed unnormalized steering
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.channel_angles: All40 ray angles independent uniform as TableI; no invented cluster centers or angular spread
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.gain: Known transduction scalar divided out of observations (G=1); NMSE invariant to known scaling
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.pilots: One fixed CN(0,1)4x35 bank; use firstP columns. No Gram screening, orthogonalization, or oracle pilot design.
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.reference: Real positive broadside constant across antennas/pilots; amplitude sqrt(10*expected signal power) for eachP
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.snr: Ensemble expected signal power M/P sum|S|^2, not realized per-channel truth; variance=power/10^(SNR/10)
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.training_snr: One model per seed trained on20k examples with uniform continuous SNR[-10,20] and P20. Distribution not given by authors.
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.training_initialization: CN(0,1), independently redrawn each epoch; fixed independent draws for validation/test, shared across all methods
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.transformer: 4heads, FFNwidth256/GELU, zero dropout, linear output projection with bias. Standard random PyTorch weights; positionalembeddingN(0,.02²).
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.exact_printed_encoder: A=MHSA(LN(V))+V; V=FFN(A)+A. No extra FFN LayerNorm or final LayerNorm.
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.filter: Raw kappa input (no log transform), hidden32/ReLU, sigmoid output; random weights
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.gates: g initialized0, alpha=.5, untied weights across10layers
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.optimizer: Adam defaults betas(.9,.999),eps1e-8,no weightdecay,gradientnormclipping1; no warmstarts/deep supervision
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.validation: 2000 independently generated cases; primary final50epoch weights, best validation checkpoint additionally reported. Never choose using test.
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.test: 2000 independent channels reused across13figure positions, with common noise draws/initializers; observedP20,SNR5point used by bothfigures
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.figure4: Diagnostic transfer of sameP20-trainedweights toP10..35; paper does not say whether separate models were trained perP
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.inference: Float64 batched accuracy; same randominit forURformer,GS100,EM100; standalone URformer no EMtail/Hankel/recovery
assumptions_not_specified_by_paper.curves: Compare URformer and two specified classical methods. CNN/blackboxTransformer architectures not specified enough for exact reproduction; excluded.

acceptance: Do not label published performance reproduced merely because training completes. Report differences to digitized published curves and unknown settings honestly. No test-guided parameter changes.
